decisions.reason: The bushing-location correction does not change the separately stated piston-end arrangement or control-piston rod motion path.
The same-message main-shaft geometry Event includes the internal bushing space but omits the required bushing-to-shaft clearance that necessarily affects the shaft interface geometry.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello [FREELANCER_NAME_002],
I have finally managed to inspect everything and review the drawings you provided.

1\. The main difference, which I had not realized before, is that we must produce premachined parts, weld them together, and carry out the final machining afterward. This applies to POS 1+2+3.

2\. The raw input material for the main shaft is tube 108/28, which will be premachined to provide the locations for POS 2+3.

3\. The previously unclear bushing is installed inside the main shaft. **IMPORTANT**: my notes state this incorrectly—the bushing is not fitted to POS 4 and belongs only in the main shaft. Please select an appropriate clearance between the bushing and shaft.

4\. POS 4 carries the piston/rod end together with the nut. The rod from the control piston, which provides the sliding movement, runs inside the main shaft. This is why the inner dia of 55mm must also be machined following welding.

5\. Cross section C-C on the mainshaft drw. shows that this keyway is to be omitted. Instead, the thread for the M100x2 locking nut needs to be wider, and the space for the main bushing must also be wider (40mm).

6\. Where possible, please number the drawings according to the numbering shown on the assembly.

Please update me on the progress, and [FREELANCER_NAME_003] you!

value_updates.locking_nut_thread_width: wider than in the reviewed drawing
value_updates.bushing_shaft_clearance: select an appropriate clearance between the bushing and shaft

decisions.reason: The bushing installation and clearance clarification does not alter the premachine-weld-final-machine fabrication sequence.
The bushing configuration does not change the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The source changes the bushing's installation and fit but does not change its CuSn12 material or any other material specification.
The design clarification must be reflected in the model, but it does not change the independent requirement to deliver a 3D assembly model.
The bushing clarification does not modify the applicable ČSN/EN standards or template policy.
The source does not change the requested IPT or STEP delivery formats.
The source requires selecting a bushing-to-shaft clearance but does not independently require a new annotation convention or explicitly change the general drawing-annotation requirement.
The clarified design must be incorporated into the drawings, but the independent obligation to provide a complete manufacturing drawing set remains unchanged.
